messages.subject: Allelic series number estimation
parts:
Hey there, 
In a multiparent population I´ve been estimating the peak marker allele effects with fit1 and blup=T. One gets the effect estimates and SE for each of the parental allele. Visually it seems that in some QTLs there are two alleles, in some 3 or 4. Anyone would have a suggestion of an analysis for estimating the number of alleles. Doing pairwise combinations?

messages.author: 96353e7106735838
messages.subject: Re: Allelic series number estimation
parts:
Consider the package TIMBR https://github.com/wesleycrouse/TIMBR
See Crouse et al (2020) https://doi.org/10.1534/genetics.120.303393

karl
